ev_0007.summary: Figure: horizontal baseline L1 (x 49-470, y=349) carrying points P(left end, label by proximity), A(142,349), D(187,349.3), E(377.5,349), Q(right end, label by proximity). Segment A-B is the vertical x=142 from A up to B(142,156.9); its drawn span stops at y=342, 7 px short of A, which is treated as the same stroke since a right-angle mark sits at A. Right angle verified at A between baseline (+x) and AB (-y). Segment C-E is L2 (C at top, passes through unlabeled points (289.8,172.9) and (313.1,219.8), ends at E on baseline). Segment C-D is L3 (C at top, overshoots baseline by 4.9 px and snaps to D). Circle_01 (center (207.4,243.2), r 108.3) passes through B and through the baseline at (230.5,349) on segment AE and near D; visible arcs are partial (69-131, 221-248, 311-357 deg), not semicircles. Circle_02 (center (332.9,241.0), r 194.4) is partial and passes no labelled vertex within 5 px; its arcs are unresolved.
